primitives.meaning: feedback submitted through any channel, attributable to a person and an experience; enough substance to say what it is about - a description, a referent, or a score with words behind it
entryFilters: feedback submitted through any channel, attributable to a person and an experience
the record has enough substance to classify; a bare score is stored as a score and not routed
no follow-up instance is already open for this feedback record

primitives.does: Persist the record with its id, source, related entity, timestamp and any sentiment or category the person themselves selected - together with what they actually wrote, kept verbatim. Everything after this is our interpretation and is stored beside their words, never over them

Classify the operational meaning as PRAISE, PRODUCT_FEEDBACK, SERVICE_ISSUE, SUPPORT_NEED, COMPLAINT, GENERAL_COMMENT or UNKNOWN, in its own field. A classification is a routing decision, not a finding about what went wrong

branches.label: PRAISE
branches.test: positive, with substance behind it

branches.label: SERVICE_ISSUE or COMPLAINT
branches.test: something went wrong, or is alleged to have

branches.label: SUPPORT_NEED
branches.test: they need help with something rather than reporting a fault

branches.label: PRODUCT_FEEDBACK
branches.test: an observation about the product that creates no obligation to this individual

branches.label: GENERAL_COMMENT
branches.test: worth keeping, nothing to do

branches.label: UNKNOWN
branches.test: the meaning cannot be established reliably enough to route

branches.label: Worth acknowledging
branches.test: they said something specific that a person could respond to

branches.label: Not needed
branches.test: an acknowledgement would be noise

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the acknowledgement should reach the person where they can keep it, which is the default for something they wrote to us
the feedback was given inside the product and the person is still there

primitives.purpose: Acknowledge the specific thing they praised. Nothing generic, nothing that reads as a template.
primitives.brief: Acknowledge the specific thing they said. A generic thank-you sent in response to praise is worse than silence, because it proves nobody read it
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

primitives.asks: Did they volunteer something reusable - a written review, a quote, a story?

branches.label: Volunteered something
branches.test: they provided content beyond an answer to our question

branches.label: Just feedback
branches.test: they answered and nothing more

carries: the explicit fact that offering it is not permission to publish it, which has to be captured separately before anything is used

primitives.asks: Does the relationship now meet advocacy eligibility?

branches.label: Eligible
branches.test: this evidence, together with what already existed, is enough to justify asking for something

branches.label: Not eligible
branches.test: this is one good signal and the relationship has not accumulated more

primitives.on: positive evidence reaching the advocacy threshold
carries: the evidence set, not only the latest item
the context the positive experience was in

primitives.state: recorded as evidence; no advocate state created
primitives.reEntry: further positive feedback opens its own record and re-weighs the evidence

primitives.does: Attach the feedback to the existing case as further context. No second case is created and no parallel recovery is opened

primitives.reEntry: the case's own lifecycle owns the outcome; the feedback record stays as evidence

primitives.does: Establish whether what they described is an actionable operational issue, or an experience we did not meet. Both are real; only one creates an obligation, and inventing the obligation to have somewhere to route to is the failure this step exists to prevent

primitives.asks: Is there an actionable operational issue?

branches.label: Actionable
branches.test: something specific can be fixed, and fixing it is ours to do

branches.label: Not actionable
branches.test: an experience we did not meet, with nothing operational to fix

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the acknowledgement should reach the person where they can keep it, which is the default for something they wrote to us
the feedback was given inside the product and the person is still there

primitives.purpose: Acknowledge what they said about an experience we did not meet, without manufacturing a fault and without offering compensation in place of a fix.
primitives.brief: Acknowledge what they said and record it as relationship evidence. No fault is manufactured, no compensation is offered as a substitute for having nothing to fix
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

primitives.reEntry: further feedback about the same experience opens its own record

branches.label: Severe
branches.test: policy defines this as requiring escalation on severity, harm, or the parties involved

branches.label: Ordinary
branches.test: actionable, at the normal level

primitives.does: Apply the policy escalation and mark the severity on the issue, so that the ownership and SLA it inherits are the escalated ones rather than the default

primitives.on: an actionable issue arising from feedback
carries: the person's own account of it, unedited
the severity and whether policy escalation was applied
the link back to the feedback record, which stays open independently
suppresses: any automated satisfaction or retention outreach about the same experience while the issue is open

primitives.does: Store it as one dated, scoped piece of positive relationship evidence. Not a label, not a state, not an advocate flag - a fact about a moment

primitives.asks: Does an open issue or case already cover this?

branches.label: Already open
branches.test: an open issue on the same experience or entity matches what they described

branches.label: Nothing open
branches.test: no open issue matches

primitives.on: feedback that cannot be classified reliably
carries: the record, unclassified, so a person reads what was written rather than a guess about it

primitives.does: Pass it to product intake as evidence. Nothing is owed to this individual in return, and nothing is promised to them

Create the work item in the owning process. From here the issue has its own lifecycle and its own owner; this record stays open independently, because the issue closing and the person hearing back are two different events

cancelOn.meaning: the operational outcome is recorded against the work item

primitives.reads: the work item re-read from the owning process: outcome recorded or still open

primitives.reEntry: the outcome arriving later re-opens this to close the loop; the issue's own journey owns the escalation, and nothing here pretends the record is finished

primitives.asks: Was a follow-up promised to the person?

branches.label: Promised
branches.test: they were told they would hear back

branches.label: Nothing promised
branches.test: no commitment was made to them

cancelOn.meaning: the follow-up that was promised is delivered

primitives.reads: the promise re-read: delivered, or still outstanding

primitives.on: a promised follow-up that did not happen
carries: what was promised, when, and what has happened operationally since

branches.label: Worth acknowledging
branches.test: they addressed us directly and would expect some response

branches.label: Not needed
branches.test: an acknowledgement would be noise

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the acknowledgement should reach the person where they can keep it, which is the default for something they wrote to us
the feedback was given inside the product and the person is still there

primitives.purpose: Acknowledge a general comment specifically enough that it is clear a person could have read it.
primitives.brief: Acknowledge specifically enough that it is clear a person could have read it
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

primitives.reEntry: the record contributes to relationship evidence and needs nothing further
further feedback about the same experience opens its own record
